name: MediaFire
description: Resolves public MediaFire file links through the documented API and the file page.

codes.mediafire.captcha_required: MediaFire asks for a captcha this plugin cannot answer
codes.mediafire.download_limit_reached: MediaFire download threshold exceeded for this address; try again in {wait_seconds} s
codes.mediafire.file_not_ready: MediaFire is still processing this file
codes.mediafire.folder_not_file: This is a MediaFire folder, not a file; folders are listed by the MediaFire folder crawler
codes.mediafire.malware_flagged: MediaFire flagged this file as malware; it is not downloaded
codes.mediafire.no_account: MediaFire resolves public files without an account; there is nothing to check
codes.mediafire.no_direct_link: MediaFire file page carried no direct link: {diagnosis}
codes.mediafire.owner_limit: MediaFire refuses the download because of the uploader's limit: {reason}
codes.mediafire.password_required: MediaFire file is password protected; file passwords are not supported yet
codes.mediafire.private_file: MediaFire file is private and needs the owner's account
codes.mediafire.rate_limited: MediaFire is rate limiting API calls from this address
codes.mediafire.temporarily_unavailable: MediaFire download is temporarily unavailable; try again in {wait_seconds} s
